items.t: Water pump and thermostat housing coolant leak
items.job: Replace water pump and thermostat housing assembly, refill coolant
items.note: One owner reported about $1,840 for the pump and thermostat. Check whether warranty still covers it.

items.t: PCV valve failure causing rough idle

items.job: Replace one ignition coil (plus spark plugs if due)

items.note: The seal is cheap; labor is high because the transmission comes out. 4Motion cars take longer.

items.t: Oil leak from upper timing cover or cam adjuster seal
items.job: Replace upper timing cover gasket or cam adjuster seal

items.t: Intake manifold flap failure and check engine light
items.note: Aftermarket flap repair kits can cost much less.

items.t: Turbo wastegate actuator failure and low power
items.note: Lower end is an actuator-only repair; the upper end is a full turbo.

items.t: Tire sidewall bubbles and blowouts on 20-inch wheels
items.job: Replace one 245/35R20 tire, mount and balance
items.note: Damaged wheels add to the cost.

items.t: Infotainment screen lags, freezes or goes black
items.note: Often free under warranty or recall; a replacement head unit costs much more.

items.t: Driver assistance warnings and false alerts
items.job: Clean sensors and recalibrate front radar/camera

items.t: Passenger airbag turned off by seat occupancy sensor
items.job: Diagnose and replace passenger seat occupancy sensor

items.t: Weak low-speed pulling power fixed by software update
items.note: Usually done free by a VW dealer.

items.t: Brake booster input rod may be installed wrong (recall)
items.note: Free at a Volkswagen dealer under the recall.

items.t: Brake booster rod connection can come loose (recall)
items.note: Free at a Volkswagen dealer under the recall.

items.t: Tire pressure monitor may miss a low tire (recall)
items.note: Free at a Volkswagen dealer under the recall.

items.t: Rearview camera goes black or infotainment freezes (recall)
items.note: Free at a Volkswagen dealer under the recall.

items.t: Rearview camera image lost from memory chip fault (recall)
items.note: Free at a Volkswagen dealer under the recall.

items.t: Rearview camera may not display at startup (recall)
items.note: Free at a Volkswagen dealer under the recall.
